text: At Meridian Quillworks I worked as a Product Analyst from 2000 to 2003, where I shortened report turnaround from 5 days to 2 days using SQL and spreadsheets.
I spent five years at Harborline Systems as Operations Lead and owned the weekly planning process, so your open operations role caught my eye.
Why this role: I enjoy turning messy reporting into something a team can trust, which is what I did as a Product Analyst at Meridian Quillworks.
At Harborline Systems I coordinated a team of 6 people and kept the planning boards honest for five years.
At Meridian Quillworks I shortened report turnaround from 5 days to 2 hours and saved the business 40% of its reporting costs.
Before Harborline Systems I spent two years at Lakeside Foundry, where I led the planning function.
As Director of Product at Meridian Quillworks I set the direction for the whole analytics group.
I spent seven years at Meridian Quillworks learning how reporting really works.
I built our dashboards in Zorbalytics and kept them current every week.
At Meridian Quillworks I single-handedly owned the entire analytics platform and every decision about it.
I am a passionate, results-driven professional who leverages cutting-edge AI to deliver transformative synergy at scale.
I am excited to bring my proven track record to your team and hit the ground running from day one.
